## Overview

**Source**: Whitmire, A. L. (2022). *Monterey Bay zooplankton data from the
Hopkins Marine Station CalCOFI program (1955-1963)*. Stanford Digital Repository,
[doi:10.25740/nt620vn7810](https://doi.org/10.25740/nt620vn7810), CC0. 18 CSVs
(`zooplankton-data-sheets-{year}_{1,2}.csv`), the README and a PDF of the methods
notes and example log sheets, under `data-public/stanford/hopkins-zooplankton/`.
Provider `stanford` (Hopkins Marine Station; the Miller Library curates the
archive).

**What a row is**: one log sheet = one sampling day, with columns for six fixed
stations in Monterey Bay. For each station the sheet records the **wet settled
volume** (mL) of a half-metre net sample (towed obliquely from 15 m) and, for each
of 24 printed taxa or groups, **the share of that volume** it made up, estimated
by eye. Two extra rows are hand-written taxa.

**Why it needs a parse step** (`libs/parse_stanford_hopkins-zooplankton.R`):

- **Every sheet was transcribed twice**, independently, by FromThePage
  volunteers. The parse pairs the two by page position and keeps a value only
  where they agree, or only one of them transcribed the cell (flagged
  `single_transcription`). Cells where they disagree are withheld and listed for
  a check against the scans (Q06).
- **Count and percent were merged.** The sheet has separate *No.* and *%* rows
  per taxon; the transcription template had one cell. Counts were only recorded
  for five or fewer individuals, so a value above 5 is a percent, but a whole
  number 1-5 is ambiguous. Those are published with
  `measurement_qual = 'unit_unclear'` (Q01).
- **Dates are written four ways**: `10-II-55` (as on the sheet), `4/2/55`
  (day-first), `2/7/61` (US month-first, for 7-II-61) and `14.VII.59`. The
  Roman-numeral form is trusted first; a slash date is read whichever way matches
  the other transcription.
- **Text values**: "trace", "<1", "no haul", "fouled", "-", and Excel-mangled
  cells ("4-Feb"). Only numbers reach the core (Q02, Q04).

```{mermaid}
graph LR
  A[sheets _1] --> P{{parse lib<br/>pair + reconcile}}
  B[sheets _2] --> P
  P --> S[hopkins_zoopl_sample<br/>sheet x station]
  P --> O[hopkins_zoopl_obs<br/>taxon cells]
  P --> K[check list<br/>for the scans]
  S --> CS[[core: sample]]
  S --> SM[[core: sample_measurement<br/>settled_volume_ml]]
  O --> CO[[core: obs<br/>percent_volume]]
  X[measurement_taxon.csv] -.taxon_key.-> CO
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

devtools::load_all(here::here("../calcofi4db"))
devtools::load_all(here::here("../calcofi4r"))
librarian::shelf(
  CalCOFI/calcofi4db, CalCOFI/calcofi4r,
  DBI, dplyr, DT, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, knitr,
  purrr, readr, stringr, tibble, tidyr, quiet = T)
options(readr.show_col_types = F)
options(DT.options = list(scrollX = TRUE))
source(here("libs/ingest.R"))
source(here("libs/parse_stanford_hopkins-zooplankton.R"))

cc           <- read_calcofi_meta(here("ingest_stanford_hopkins-zooplankton.qmd"))
provider     <- cc$provider
dataset      <- cc$dataset
tables_owned <- cc$tables_owned
ds_key       <- glue("{provider}_{dataset}")
dir_label    <- ds_key
dir_parquet  <- here(glue("data/parquet/{dir_label}"))
dir_stage    <- cc_stage_path("parquet", dir_label, create = TRUE)
db_path      <- here(glue("data/wrangling/{dir_label}.duckdb"))
dir_src      <- path_expand(glue("{dir_data}/{provider}/{dataset}"))

if (overwrite) {
  if (file_exists(db_path))                 file_delete(db_path)
  if (file_exists(paste0(db_path, ".wal"))) file_delete(paste0(db_path, ".wal"))
}
dir_create(dirname(db_path))
con <- get_duckdb_con(db_path)
load_duckdb_extension(con, "spatial")

hop_tbls <- c("hopkins_zoopl_sample", "hopkins_zoopl_obs")

# the sampling net: lowered vertically to 15 m, then towed obliquely to the
# surface (README methods), so every tow spans 0-15 m
net_depth_max_m <- 15
```

## Read Source

The CSVs are CC0 (SDR record and README), so the source folder is archived
publicly like every other ingest.

```{r}
#| label: read-source

stopifnot("source dir not found" = dir_exists(dir_src))
if (Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_SKIP_GCS") == "") {
  sync_to_gcs(local_dir = dir_src, gcs_prefix = glue("archive/{provider}/{dataset}"),
              bucket = "calcofi-files-public",
              exclude = c(".DS_Store", "*.tmp", "__MACOSX/*"))
} else cat("CALCOFI_SKIP_GCS set — sources not archived (local verification run)\n")

z <- tidy_hopkins_zoopl(dir_src)

n_sheets <- n_distinct(z$sample$year, z$sample$page_position)
cat(glue("sheets {n_sheets} (1955-1963); station rows {nrow(z$sample)}; ",
         "non-blank taxon cells {nrow(z$obs)}; to check against the scans {nrow(z$check)}"), "\n")

# hold the parse to the release it was written against (SDR version 1,
# 2025-07-07): a re-export that changes the files fails loudly here
stopifnot(
  "expected 324 non-blank sheets across the 9 file pairs" = n_sheets == 324,
  "expected 6 station rows per sheet" = nrow(z$sample) == 6 * n_sheets,
  "every sheet date within 1955-1963" =
    all(is.na(z$sample$date) | between(as.integer(format(z$sample$date, "%Y")), 1955, 1963)))
```

## What the Parse Decided

Agreement between the two transcriptions, and how each non-blank taxon cell was
classified. Only `value_code = number` reaches the core.

```{r}
#| label: parse-summary

z$obs |>
  count(value_code, unit, agreement, name = "cells") |>
  arrange(value_code, unit, agreement) |>
  datatable(caption = "Taxon cells by value code, unit and transcription agreement",
            options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 50), rownames = FALSE)

z$sample |>
  distinct(year, page_position, date_flag) |>
  count(date_flag, name = "sheets") |>
  datatable(caption = "Sheet dates: ok, or why they need a look (see the check list)",
            options = list(dom = "t"), rownames = FALSE)
```

The check list for the scans (Q06). Each row links both transcriptions on
FromThePage, where the scanned page sits beside the transcription.

```{r}
#| label: check-list

z$check |>
  datatable(caption = "Cells and dates to check against the scans (Q06)",
            rownames = FALSE, filter = "top")
```

## Build Working Tables

`hopkins_zoopl_sample` keeps every sheet x station; the core takes only the
**sampled** rows with a **date** (a station marked "no haul" or left entirely
blank was not sampled; five sheets have no readable date on either
transcription). `tow_id` is `{year}-{page_position}-{station}`, stable across
re-runs because it comes from the file layout, not the row order.

```{r}
#| label: build-tables

d_sample <- z$sample |>
  mutate(
    tow_id = sprintf("%d-%02d-%d", year, page_position, station),
    emit   = coalesce(sampled, FALSE) & !is.na(date)) |>
  select(tow_id, year, page_position, station, date, date_flag, sampled, emit,
         wet_volume_ml, wet_volume_code, wet_volume_agreement,
         latitude, longitude, cast_depth_m, page_url_1, page_url_2)

d_obs <- z$obs |>
  mutate(tow_id = sprintf("%d-%02d-%d", year, page_position, station)) |>
  select(tow_id, item_seq, taxon_label, raw_measurement_type, value, unit,
         value_code, agreement, value_raw_1, value_raw_2)

stopifnot(
  "tow_id must be unique" = !anyDuplicated(d_sample$tow_id),
  "every obs cell must belong to a sheet x station" = all(d_obs$tow_id %in% d_sample$tow_id))

dbWriteTable(con, "hopkins_zoopl_sample", as.data.frame(d_sample), overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "hopkins_zoopl_obs",    as.data.frame(d_obs),    overwrite = TRUE)

cat(glue("tows to emit: {sum(d_sample$emit)} of {nrow(d_sample)} sheet x station rows ",
         "({sum(d_sample$sampled %in% TRUE & is.na(d_sample$date))} sampled but undated, ",
         "{sum(!(d_sample$sampled %in% TRUE))} not sampled or blank)"), "\n")
```

## Enforce Column Types

Before any geometry exists (DuckDB >= 1.5.1 cannot rewrite a table carrying
`GEOMETRY`; see `CLAUDE.md`).

```{r}
#| label: enforce-types

d_flds_rd <- read_csv(here(glue("metadata/{provider}/{dataset}/flds_redefine.csv")))
enforce_column_types(con, d_flds_rd = d_flds_rd, tables = hop_tbls)
```

## Spatial

Positions are the six station coordinates from the README. `grid_key` is
whichever CalCOFI grid cell each station falls in, if any: these are inshore
Monterey Bay stations, so some or all may fall outside the grid and keep a NULL
`grid_key` (Q08).

```{r}
#| label: spatial

load_prior_tables(
  con, parquet_dir = cc_stage_path("parquet", "swfsc_ichthyo"),
  gcs_prefix = "ingest/swfsc_ichthyo",  # public GCS copy when not staged locally
  tables = c("grid"), geom_tables = c("grid"), as_view = TRUE)

add_point_geom(con, "hopkins_zoopl_sample", lon_col = "longitude", lat_col = "latitude")
assign_grid_key(con, "hopkins_zoopl_sample")

d_grid <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT station, ANY_VALUE(latitude) AS latitude, ANY_VALUE(longitude) AS longitude,
         ANY_VALUE(grid_key) AS grid_key
  FROM hopkins_zoopl_sample GROUP BY station ORDER BY station")

# the borrowed grid has done its job; drop it so validation and the metadata
# sidecar see only this dataset's tables. A VIEW when read from the local stage,
# a TABLE when read from GCS (the GCS fallback ignores as_view)
grid_type <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'grid'")$table_type
if (length(grid_type))
  dbExecute(con, if (grid_type == "VIEW") "DROP VIEW grid" else "DROP TABLE grid")

d_grid |>
  datatable(caption = "Station -> grid cell (NULL = outside the CalCOFI grid, Q08)",
            options = list(dom = "t"), rownames = FALSE)
```

## Measurement Vocabulary + Dataset Metadata

Two quantities:

- `settled_volume_ml`, already registered (by `cdfw_dungeness-crab`), for the
  wet settled volume, at the sample level;
- `percent_volume`, **new** in this change, for each taxon's share of that
  volume, at the obs level. Bounded 0-100.

The taxon lives in `taxon_key`, never in the type name: the 24 printed rows map to
`(measurement_type = percent_volume, taxon_key, life_stage)` through
`metadata/measurement_taxon.csv`. The quality codes (`unit_unclear`,
`single_transcription`) are registered in `metadata/measurement_qual.csv` under
code set `hopkins-zooplankton`.

```{r}
#| label: meas-types

d_meas_type <- read_measurement_type(here("metadata/measurement_type.csv"))
stopifnot(
  "percent_volume and settled_volume_ml must be in the shared registry" =
    all(c("percent_volume", "settled_volume_ml") %in% d_meas_type$measurement_type))
dbWriteTable(con, "measurement_type", as.data.frame(d_meas_type), overwrite = TRUE)

this_provider <- provider; this_dataset <- dataset   # also column names
d_dataset <- ingest_yaml_to_dataset_df(read_ingest_yaml(here())) |>
  filter(provider == this_provider, dataset == this_dataset)
stopifnot("this dataset must appear in the ingest YAML registry" = nrow(d_dataset) == 1)
dbWriteTable(con, "dataset", as.data.frame(d_dataset), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Emit Core Tables

Project into the shared core (`RUNBOOK.md` §3b) with the generic `append_*`
helpers; no `calcofi4db` change is needed.

- **`sample`**: one `tow` per emitted sheet x station, keyed
  `stanford_hopkins-zooplankton:tow:{year}-{page_position}-{station}`, depth
  0-15 m, no parent. `cruise_key` and `site_key` are NULL: these were Hopkins
  day trips, not CalCOFI ship cruises, and the six stations are not on the CalCOFI
  line/station pattern (Q08). The date carries no time of day, so `datetime` is
  midnight of the sample date.
- **`obs`**: one row per numeric taxon cell (log-sheet rows 1-24) on an emitted
  tow. `measurement_qual` is NULL where both transcriptions agree and the value is
  unambiguous, else `unit_unclear`, `single_transcription`, or both.
- **`sample_measurement`**: the wet settled volume where it is a number.
- **Not published** (kept in the archived source and the check list): cells the
  transcriptions disagree on, "trace" / "<1" (Q02), dashes and unparsed text
  (Q04), the hand-written rows 25 and *bottom* (Q05), and absences (Q03).

```{r}
#| label: emit-core

# the crosswalk, restricted to this dataset. worms_id/itis_id MUST be integer:
# read as double, CAST(... AS VARCHAR) yields "1100.0" and every taxon_key
# silently fails to resolve against `taxon`
mt_taxon <- read_csv(here("metadata/measurement_taxon.csv"),
                     col_types = cols(worms_id = "i", itis_id = "i",
                                      bin_value = "d", .default = "c")) |>
  filter(dataset_key == ds_key)
tx_over  <- read_csv(here("metadata/taxon_override.csv"))
stopifnot(
  "crosswalk must cover all 24 printed log-sheet rows" =
    setequal(mt_taxon$raw_measurement_type,
             unique(na.omit(d_obs$raw_measurement_type))),
  "every crosswalk row needs a worms_id: fill it in metadata/measurement_taxon.csv (exact WoRMS match)" =
    !anyNA(mt_taxon$worms_id))

ensure_taxon_xref(con, mt_taxon, tx_over, cache_csv = here("metadata/taxon_xref.csv"))
ensure_taxon_lineage(con, mt_taxon, tx_over, cache_csv = here("metadata/taxon_lineage.csv"))
n_taxon    <- build_taxon_reference(con, mt_taxon, tx_over)
n_ds_taxon <- resolve_dataset_taxon(con, mt_taxon, tx_over)
n_tx_group <- build_taxon_group(con, read_taxon_group_rules(here("metadata/taxon_group.csv")))
ensure_measurement_taxon(con, mt_taxon, dataset_key = ds_key)

tow_key <- glue("'{ds_key}:tow:' || s.tow_id")

# 1. sample — one tow per emitted sheet x station
append_sample(con, glue("
  SELECT {tow_key}, 'tow', NULL::VARCHAR, {tow_key},
         '{ds_key}', s.grid_key, NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::INTEGER,
         s.latitude, s.longitude, CAST(s.date AS TIMESTAMP),
         0::DOUBLE, {net_depth_max_m}::DOUBLE, NULL::VARCHAR
  FROM hopkins_zoopl_sample s
  WHERE s.emit"))

# 2. obs — percent of the settled volume per printed taxon
obs_qual <- "
  CASE
    WHEN o.unit = 'unit_unclear' AND o.agreement IN ('only_1', 'only_2')
      THEN 'unit_unclear;single_transcription'
    WHEN o.unit = 'unit_unclear'                  THEN 'unit_unclear'
    WHEN o.agreement IN ('only_1', 'only_2')      THEN 'single_transcription'
  END"
obs_where <- "
  s.emit AND o.value_code = 'number' AND o.item_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 24"

append_obs(con, glue("
  SELECT 'bio', '{ds_key}', {tow_key},
         s.grid_key, NULL::VARCHAR, s.latitude, s.longitude,
         CAST(s.date AS TIMESTAMP), 0::DOUBLE, {net_depth_max_m}::DOUBLE,
         mx.taxon_key, mx.life_stage, mx.measurement_type, o.value,
         {obs_qual}, NULL::DOUBLE
  FROM hopkins_zoopl_obs o
  JOIN hopkins_zoopl_sample s USING (tow_id)
  JOIN _measurement_taxon mx
    ON mx.raw_measurement_type = o.raw_measurement_type AND mx.target = 'obs'
  WHERE {obs_where}"))

# 3. sample_measurement — wet settled volume
append_sample_measurement(con, glue("
  SELECT {tow_key}, '{ds_key}', 'settled_volume_ml', s.wet_volume_ml,
         CASE WHEN s.wet_volume_agreement IN ('only_1', 'only_2')
              THEN 'single_transcription' END
  FROM hopkins_zoopl_sample s
  WHERE s.emit AND s.wet_volume_code = 'number'"))

core_n <- list(
  sample             = dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sample")[[1]],
  obs                = dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs")[[1]],
  sample_measurement = dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sample_measurement")[[1]],
  taxon = n_taxon, dataset_taxon = n_ds_taxon, taxon_group = n_tx_group)
cat(glue("core projection — ",
         "{paste(names(core_n), unlist(core_n), sep = '=', collapse = '  ')}"), "\n")
```

The projection must be lossless and must not invent anything:

```{r}
#| label: core-parity

q1 <- function(sql) dbGetQuery(con, sql)[[1]]
n_emit  <- sum(d_sample$emit)
src_obs <- d_obs |>
  inner_join(filter(d_sample, emit) |> select(tow_id), by = "tow_id") |>
  filter(value_code == "number", between(item_seq, 1, 24))
src_vol <- filter(d_sample, emit, wet_volume_code == "number")

stopifnot(
  "one core sample per emitted tow" = core_n$sample == n_emit,
  "sample_key must be unique" =
    q1("SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sample_key) FROM sample") == 0,
  "obs must carry every emitted source cell, no more" = core_n$obs == nrow(src_obs),
  "obs total must equal the source total" =
    isTRUE(all.equal(q1("SELECT SUM(measurement_value) FROM obs"), sum(src_obs$value))),
  "every obs.sample_key must resolve in sample" =
    q1("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs o LEFT JOIN sample s USING (sample_key)
        WHERE s.sample_key IS NULL") == 0,
  # NOT-NULL is not enough: a numeric-typed worms_id renders as "1100.0", which
  # is non-NULL and joins to nothing. Assert the FK actually resolves.
  "every obs.taxon_key must resolve in taxon" =
    q1("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs o LEFT JOIN taxon t USING (taxon_key)
        WHERE t.taxon_key IS NULL") == 0,
  "every obs.measurement_type must resolve in measurement_type" =
    q1("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs o LEFT JOIN measurement_type t USING (measurement_type)
        WHERE t.measurement_type IS NULL") == 0,
  "percent_volume must stay within 0-100" =
    q1("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs WHERE measurement_value < 0 OR measurement_value > 100") == 0,
  "unit_unclear must mean exactly the whole numbers 1-5" =
    q1("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs WHERE measurement_qual LIKE 'unit_unclear%'") ==
      sum(src_obs$unit == "unit_unclear"),
  "one settled volume per emitted tow that has one" =
    core_n$sample_measurement == nrow(src_vol),
  "no cruise_key is invented (Q08)" =
    q1("SELECT COUNT(cruise_key) FROM sample") == 0)
cat("core parity: all assertions passed\n")

dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT COALESCE(t.scientific_name, o.taxon_key) AS taxon, o.life_stage,
         COUNT(*) AS n_obs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.measurement_qual LIKE 'unit_unclear%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unit_unclear,
         ROUND(AVG(o.measurement_value), 1) AS mean_value
  FROM obs o LEFT JOIN taxon t USING (taxon_key)
  GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n_obs DESC") |>
  datatable(caption = "obs by resolved taxon", rownames = FALSE)
```

## Check Declared Bounds

Not optional (`RUNBOOK.md` §3b). Run on what is actually published, the core
tables: `percent_volume` is declared 0-100 and `settled_volume_ml` 0-10,000 mL
in `metadata/measurement_type.csv`.

```{r}
#| label: bounds-core

d_bounds <- bind_rows(
  check_measurement_bounds(con, "obs", mt = d_meas_type, dataset_key = ds_key),
  check_measurement_bounds(con, "sample_measurement", mt = d_meas_type, dataset_key = ds_key))
bounds_datatable(d_bounds)
stopifnot(
  "every published type must declare a bound" = !any(d_bounds$status == "undeclared"),
  "no published value may lie outside its declared bound" =
    !any(d_bounds$status == "out_of_range"))
```

## Validate

```{r}
#| label: validate

results <- validate_for_release(con, checks = "all", strict = FALSE)
cat("Validation:", ifelse(results$passed, "PASSED", "FAILED"), "\n")
if (length(results$errors) > 0)
  cat("Errors:\n", paste("-", results$errors, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
if (length(results$warnings) > 0)
  cat("Warnings:\n", paste("-", results$warnings, collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# validate_for_release() treats every *_id / *_key column as required, a
# heuristic rather than this dataset's contract. Every expected NULL is declared
# with its count and reason; anything undeclared, or a count that moves, fails.
# Counts from the first render, 2026-10-12. All six stations fall in one grid
# cell (st50-ln66.7), so grid_key is not on this list.
nullable <- tribble(
  ~table,   ~column,             ~n,    ~reason,
  "sample", "cruise_key",        1702L, "Hopkins weekly day trips, not CalCOFI ship cruises (Q08)",
  "sample", "site_key",          1702L, "the six Hopkins stations are not on the CalCOFI line/station pattern (Q08)",
  "sample", "parent_sample_key", 1702L, "each tow is a root sample; no parent event in this dataset",
  "obs",    "cruise_key",        2462L, "inherits the sample's NULL cruise_key (Q08)",
  # 98 taxa = 23 crosswalk taxa + their WoRMS lineage ancestors
  "taxon",  "itis_id",           14L,   "WoRMS links no ITIS TSN for these lineage nodes",
  "taxon",  "gbif_id",           98L,   "nothing asks GBIF; no GBIF crosswalk in the xref",
  "taxon",  "ncbi_id",           98L,   "never populated by any dataset",
  "taxon",  "inat_id",           98L,   "never populated by any dataset",
  "taxon",  "parent_taxon_key",  1L,    "the lineage root (Biota) has no parent")

nulls <- results$checks |>
  filter(check == "nulls", status != "PASS") |>
  mutate(column = str_match(message, "column '([^']+)'")[, 2],
         n      = as.integer(str_match(message, "has (\\d+) NULL")[, 2])) |>
  select(table, column, n)

reconciled  <- full_join(nulls, select(nullable, table, column, n_expected = n),
                         by = c("table", "column"))
unexplained <- filter(reconciled, is.na(n_expected))
moved       <- filter(reconciled, !is.na(n_expected), !is.na(n), n != n_expected)
resolved    <- filter(reconciled, !is.na(n_expected), is.na(n))
if (nrow(unexplained)) print(unexplained)
if (nrow(moved)) print(moved)
stopifnot(
  "a NULL appeared in a column with no declared reason: investigate, don't just add it" =
    nrow(unexplained) == 0,
  "a declared NULL count changed: the data moved, so re-derive the reason" =
    nrow(moved) == 0)
if (nrow(resolved))
  cat(glue("{nrow(resolved)} declared nullable case(s) no longer occur, prune them: ",
           "{paste(resolved$table, resolved$column, sep = '.', collapse = ', ')}"), "\n")
cat("validate: every NULL is declared\n")
```

## Schema

### What the source looks like — the working tables

The parse lib turns the 18 CSVs into two working tables. They are not
published; the core below is.

```{r}
#| label: schema-source

hop_rels <- list(
  primary_keys = list(hopkins_zoopl_sample = "tow_id"),
  foreign_keys = list(
    list(table = "hopkins_zoopl_obs", column = "tow_id",
         ref_table = "hopkins_zoopl_sample", ref_column = "tow_id")))
cc_erd(con, tables = hop_tbls, rels = hop_rels,
       colors = list(lightblue = hop_tbls))
```

### What gets published — the core

```{r}
#| label: schema-core

core_tbls <- core_output_tables(con, extra = "measurement_type")
cc_erd(con, tables = core_tbls, rels = core_relationships(core_tbls),
       colors = list(
         lightblue   = c("sample", "obs"),
         lightgreen  = c("sample_measurement"),
         lightyellow = c("taxon", "dataset_taxon", "measurement_type")))
```

### How the source maps onto it

```{r}
#| label: source-to-core
#| echo: false

tribble(
  ~source, ~`core table`, ~`core field`, ~transform,
  "file year + Page Position + station column", "sample", "sample_key",
    "'stanford_hopkins-zooplankton:tow:{year}-{page_position}-{station}'",
  "Date (text), both transcriptions", "sample", "datetime",
    "Roman-numeral date trusted first; slash dates read to match the other transcription; year from the file; midnight (no time recorded)",
  "station 1-6", "sample", "latitude / longitude",
    "README station coordinates",
  "(net method)", "sample", "depth_min_m / depth_max_m", "0 / 15 m (README)",
  "Wet settled volume (mL)", "sample_measurement", "measurement_value",
    "measurement_type = 'settled_volume_ml'; numbers only",
  "rows 1-24, station columns", "obs", "measurement_value",
    "measurement_type = 'percent_volume'; consensus of the two transcriptions",
  "rows 1-24 labels", "obs", "taxon_key / life_stage",
    "metadata/measurement_taxon.csv",
  "agreement + value range", "obs", "measurement_qual",
    "unit_unclear (whole 1-5), single_transcription, or both",
  "rows 25 + bottom (write-ins)", "(not published)", "", "Q05",
  "trace / <1, dashes, unparsed text", "(not published)", "", "Q02, Q04",
  "cells the transcriptions disagree on", "(not published)", "", "Q06 check list",
  "blank taxon cells", "(not published)", "", "absence uncertain, Q03",
  "Σ columns on the sheet", "(not published)", "", "derived on the sheet, not observed",
  "NOTES, MISCELLANEOUS", "(not published)", "", "kept in the archived source; feeds Q01") |>
  datatable(caption = "Source -> core mapping", rownames = FALSE,
            options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 50))
```

## Preview

Through the core, the way a consumer reads it.

```{r}
#| label: preview

dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT s.sample_key, CAST(s.datetime AS DATE) AS date, s.latitude, s.longitude,
         t.scientific_name, o.life_stage, o.measurement_value AS percent_volume,
         o.measurement_qual
  FROM obs o JOIN sample s USING (sample_key) LEFT JOIN taxon t USING (taxon_key)
  ORDER BY s.datetime, s.sample_key, t.scientific_name
  LIMIT 500")) |>
  datatable(caption = "obs joined to sample and taxon (first 500)",
            rownames = FALSE, filter = "top")
```

## Write Outputs

The core and nothing else.

```{r}
#| label: write-parquet

dir_create(dir_parquet)
tbls_out <- core_output_tables(con, extra = c("measurement_type", "dataset"))
parquet_stats <- write_parquet_outputs(
  con = con, output_dir = dir_parquet, tables = tbls_out,
  sort_by = list(obs = c("grid_key", "measurement_type")),
  strip_provenance = FALSE)

build_relationships_json(
  rels = core_relationships(tbls_out), output_dir = dir_parquet,
  provider = provider, dataset = dataset)

parquet_stats |> mutate(file = basename(path)) |> select(-path) |>
  datatable(caption = "Parquet export statistics")
```

```{r}
#| label: write-metadata

d_tbls_rd <- read_csv(here(glue("metadata/{provider}/{dataset}/tbls_redefine.csv")))
metadata_path <- build_metadata_json(
  con = con, d_tbls_rd = d_tbls_rd, d_flds_rd = d_flds_rd,
  metadata_derived_csv = c(here("metadata/core_dictionary.csv"),
                           here(glue("metadata/{provider}/{dataset}/metadata_derived.csv"))),
  output_dir = dir_parquet, tables = tbls_out,
  set_comments = TRUE, provider = provider, dataset = dataset,
  workflow_url = cc$workflow_url, tables_owned = tables_owned)
```

```{r}
#| label: upload-gcs

if (Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_SKIP_GCS") == "") {
  sync_to_gcs(local_dir = dir_stage, sidecar_dir = dir_parquet,
              gcs_prefix = glue("ingest/{dir_label}"), bucket = "calcofi-db")
} else cat("CALCOFI_SKIP_GCS set — skipping the upload (local verification run)\n")
```

```{r}

close_duckdb(con)
cat(glue("parquet outputs written to: {dir_parquet}"), "\n")
```
